== Course of events ==

After the croquet game, in which the Queen has pronounced sentence of execution upon numerous players, Alice encounters the Gryphon. The Gryphon tells Alice a curious thing: that the Queen's threats are empty. The Gryphon tells Alice, moreover, that no one actually dies.

Following this exchange with the Gryphon, the Mock Turtle then begins to recount his remarkable history to Alice, explaining how he was once a true turtle who attended school in the sea.
